title: What is Memory in ChatGPT?

body.text: feature lets ChatGPT remember important details about you across conversations — your name, job, preferences, or goals — so you don't have to reintroduce yourself every time you start a new chat.

example: "Remember that I'm a high-school English teacher and I like using everyday-life examples."

title: Managing ChatGPT's Memory

body.text: under Settings > Personalization > Memory. ChatGPT shows everything it has remembered, and you control what it keeps or forgets.

example: "Forget the info about my old project, and remember that I now work in the fintech industry."

question: What does the Memory feature do in ChatGPT?

options.text: Lets ChatGPT remember your info across chats, so you don't reintroduce yourself

question: Where do you manage ChatGPT's Memory?
What's an example of info worth letting ChatGPT remember?

options.text: Your job, preferences, and work-related goals

question: You want ChatGPT to suggest menus knowing you're allergic to cow's milk. What should you do?

options.text: Tell it this and have it saved to Memory

question: Which is appropriate to let ChatGPT remember via Memory?

options.text: Your job, preferences, and the work style you use regularly
